meta.methodology: Official sources establish the live roster and documented balance changes. They do not publish a complete comparative ranking, so this dataset assigns no letter or numeric rank. PvE and PvP evaluations remain needs-retest until the same build, gear tier, encounter set, latency range, and sample size can be compared after the current patch.
reviewProtocol: Confirm the weapon or Martial Art is live from an official game source.
Record every relevant official balance change for the current version.
Test PvE with matched gear and repeatable boss or dungeon encounters.
Test PvP across several matchups and record latency, rank band, build, and sample size.
Publish comparative tiers only when the evidence is reproducible and dated.
